system.description:
No order, no lord, no stronghold — just the code and the road.

  • Universal Bearing: Inspire bonus applies even to creatures who cannot understand the knight's language, and affects double the normal number of creatures at each threshold.
  • Roads Well Travelled: Advantage on Legend Lore-equivalent checks about distant lands, the history of knighthood, or famous deeds of arms.
